scenarios.name: sacrifice-creature-for-two-colourless
scenarios.why: 'Sacrifice a creature: Add {C}{C}' is a mana ability whose cost is sacrificing a creature, so sacrificing the 2/2 Bears leaves the creature in the graveyard and adds exactly two colourless mana to the pool.

scenarios.name: no-other-creature-no-offer
scenarios.why: The cost is a creature sacrifice; with no creature other than the (non-creature) Altar on the battlefield the ability has no legal way to be activated and must not be offered.
